title: Concept: Second factor disabled on a privileged account
description: An mfaEnabled flag set to false beside an administrative role in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The account holds elevated rights without the second factor, so a password alone is enough to reach the back office.
applicability: Deployments that render an mfaEnabled flag set to false beside an administrative role into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The account holds elevated rights without the second factor, so a password alone is enough to reach the back office.
